GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: Conducted a comprehensive search for Atomos-related content published on November 14, 2026, focusing on official announcements, product updates, and corporate communications. Excluded content unrelated to Atomos professional video production hardware, such as Final Fantasy XIV Atomos server, DJ Atomos, rap music, and ancient Greek atomism. Prioritized original-source articles with explicit mentions of Atomos in a camera or recording context.
